items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, after he insisted on making an album with Johnny Hodges, I knew he had to be all right. [INTERVIEWEE] I was on that, too.

ctx.x: Well, after he insisted on making an album with Johnny Hodges, I knew he had to be all right.

I was on that, too. No, Lawrence Welk I guess a lot of people don't understand. But what's wrong with Lawrence Welk? I like him. He plays the melody. And also, at least once or twice a year, he writes a tune I wrote, my only Pop hit tune, "Primrose Lane." So every time I would see him, he'd say, "Hey, I played your tune."
